evening_fueling_report.source: Athlete voice note supplied by coach on 2026-09-23; athlete report, not an app completion receipt.
evening_fueling_report.report: Adrian reported completing his run and strides, then lifting at night. He stopped after the first four of seven exercises because he was very hungry, tired and thirsty after a long gap without eating. He also reported cooked food had been sitting in the microwave for about two hours.
evening_fueling_report.interpretation: Athlete report of hunger, thirst and tiredness, with incomplete timing context. Not proof of nonadherence, a cause of fatigue or a measured calorie deficit.
evening_fueling_report.response: Breakfast is no longer conditional on training time. The 3:30 meal anchors evening training, the backup meal is used when that meal was missed, and room-temperature food holding is clarified.
evening_fueling_report.prior_response_status: The earlier food-before-training response is superseded by the individualized timing rule. Retain the earlier response only as a dated decision, not active advice.
evening_fueling_report.current_response: Fit adequate meals around clinician-confirmed food/exercise guidance; no automatic pre-session snack, lifting exemption or immediate post-exercise meal.

pre_run_food_rule.source: Athlete report supplied by coach on 2026-09-23.
pre_run_food_rule.rule: Athlete reports avoiding food for several hours before running. This remains a report, not a verified safety interval or a new fasting prescription.
pre_run_food_rule.honey_stinger: Athlete reports a small Honey Stinger waffle before prior long runs. Recorded as prior practice, not a newly prescribed or guaranteed-safe exception.
pre_run_food_rule.trigger_status: No trigger food is identified by this public nutrition plan.

nutrition_delivery.workday_breakfast: Retain breakfast as a meal reference. Its timing follows individualized clinician guidance before and after exercise, not a fixed 8 a.m. deadline, between-session snack or immediate post-exercise instruction.
nutrition_delivery.weekends: Family restaurant meals replace home meals. Explicit Saturday/Sunday and late-lunch instructions. No mandatory second pasta box on Saturday.
nutrition_delivery.initial_prep: Sunday four portions: three refrigerated Mon-Wed and one frozen backup. Wednesday half batch: two refrigerated Thu-Fri.
nutrition_delivery.carryover: When one spare remains, thaw for Monday; Sunday cook four, refrigerate Tue-Wed, freeze Thu-Fri, skip Wednesday cook. Unexpected surplus prompts inventory adjustment.
recipes: Classic spaghetti with meat sauce and Parmesan
nutrition_delivery.recipe_equivalence: Different cream/cheese finishes are not calorie/protein-equivalent. These adaptations have not been kitchen-tested for Adrian; observe taste, yield, appetite and digestion.
nutrition_delivery.long_run_fuel: No new food, gel, waffle, powder or snack is prescribed around exercise. Prior Honey Stinger use is an athlete report only, not a confirmed safe exception.
nutrition_delivery.photo_checkin: Two complete photo-days: one normal workday and Saturday. Replaces four isolated meal photos.
nutrition_delivery.bedtime_progression: First three nights phone 23:00 / lights out 23:30, both 30 minutes earlier every three nights to 21:00 / 21:30; opportunity is not measured sleep.
nutrition_delivery.evening_training: Runs and lifts use the same individual timing review. If the afternoon meal conflicts, keep it refrigerated and have the coach reschedule it within clinician guidance. No last-minute sandwich workaround or automatic meal immediately afterward.
nutrition_delivery.supplement_status: Bone-broth protein and creatine use reported, products/doses unverified. Leave unreviewed powders out pending label review. No new creatine prescription.
nutrition_delivery.reference_scope: Recipes, portions, shopping and prep tools remain available as references. Foods and times must fit individualized clinical guidance; no food is diagnosed as a trigger or medically cleared by this page.

machine_readability: All athlete-facing instructions are static HTML, including native details contents. The HTML head links this JSON. Read the public authored program JSON without depending on JavaScript rendering; use authorized repository access for pinned native sources.
privacy_boundary: This public reference manifest contains no credentials, athlete emails, backend tokens, or private completed-session logs. Hiding HTML is not access control. Future Forge completion review must use authenticated, authorized data access, not a public JSON export.
interpretation_boundary: Keep athlete reports, observations, measured outcomes and decisions separate. Publication does not confirm adherence or causation. The food-timing constraint is reported practice, not clinical clearance. Brands, doses and start dates for reported supplements remain unknown; do not attribute weight or lean-mass changes to them. Private medical history is not published.
